1532401.name: Small Esophagus
1532401.description: Uses Small Esophagus, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1532403.name: Hard Cell
1532403.description:
Fires a huge amount of Hard Cells from its mouth, dealing damage to all Nikkes and cover.
Hard Cells can be intercepted.

1532404.name: Solid Cell
1532404.description:
Fires Solid Cells from its mouth, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Deals additional damage if the attack hits.

1532405.name: Restraint Signal
1532405.description: Launches a restraint signal, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1532406.name: Buffer Mode
1532406.description: Covers its whole body in slime, significantly reducing damage to all parts except Cancel Rings.

1532408.name: Autophagy Discharge
1532408.description:
Performs autophagy before discharging, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Deals additional damage if the attack hits.
Can be interrupted by attacking the Cancel Ring.
Damage increases according to the autophagy phase and penetrates the cover.

1532412.name: Gluttony
1532412.description: Devours all Nikkes. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, the entire squad is wiped out.

1532418.name: Enhanced Small Esophagus
1532418.description:
Uses Enhanced Small Esophagus, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Gluttony generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Enhanced Small Esophagus. While the barrier is up, only Fire Code Nikkes can deal damage.
